{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZgAtYA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDHKmk", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 99, "title": "Add an evidence-qualified restricted FTP acquisition journey from MAIN 7", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `2383f8043185a1977871a3bd3e1d2c9033d4383b`, MAIN `7 インターネット` offers only NetNews and TELNET. Users cannot browse or acquire files through the documented restricted FTP service.

The [April 1995 Internet Magazine report, printed page 105](https://iwparchives.jp/wp-content/themes/twentytwelve/bn/pdf/im199504-104-bbs.pdf) explicitly limits PC-VAN FTP to `info.mac`. The [Internet White Paper 1996 comparison, printed page 111 and labeled January 1996](https://iwparchives.jp/files/pdf/iwp1996/iwp1996-ch04-01-p110.pdf) repeats that restriction. This is an omitted journey, rather than a demonstrated regression.

## Expected outcome

Provide this complete browser-local keyboard journey:

`MAIN or index → 7 Internet → 3 FTP → info.mac example file list → text preview → DOWNLOAD number → explicit confirmation → exact bundled-file download → contextual return`

Provide two small original Macintosh-oriented text files: an introductory document-handling note and a communications checklist. They should demonstrate acquiring useful documentation without reproducing archived software, messages, identities or images. Use truthful `.TXT` filenames, exact UTF-8 byte counts and explicitly authored dates no later than the fictional November 1996 setting.

Use the existing product conventions `READ number`, `DOWNLOAD number`, `LIST`, `HELP`, `BACK` and `MAIN`. These are reconstructed controls. Keep `info.mac` as the documented collection label; do not invent a functioning hostname or connection sequence.

## Context

Historical sources were inspected live on 2026-10-24:

- [Internet Magazine, April 1995, page 105](https://iwparchives.jp/wp-content/themes/twentytwelve/bn/pdf/im199504-104-bbs.pdf): high confidence in the stated PC-VAN destination restriction within that earlier snapshot. The adjacent illustrated FTP menus are explicitly ASAHI Net and cannot establish PC-VAN commands, paging or transfer controls.
- [Internet White Paper 1996, page 111](https://iwparchives.jp/files/pdf/iwp1996/iwp1996-ch04-01-p110.pdf): high confidence in the extracted PC-VAN FTP restriction and January dating. This comparison supplies no activation date, late-year change history or host sequence. No usable page-image comparison was obtained.
- [Internet Magazine, January 1996, page 229](https://iwparchives.jp/wp-content/themes/twentytwelve/bn/pdf/im199601-216-news.pdf): a contemporary review lists FTP among PC-VAN's existing Internet services while describing the separate Mosaic/Navigator environment. It corroborates availability, not terminal syntax.
- [Info-Mac Digest, July 13, 1996](https://info-mac.org/viewtopic.php?p=16139): the preserved moderators' introduction describes an FTP-accessible archive with help files and indexes. This supports documentation-oriented examples. It does not establish PC-VAN's particular catalog, mirror, filenames or acquisition procedure. Inspection focused on archive framing and structure; do not reuse correspondence or identities.

Judgment: capability is sufficiently supported for implementation. Continuing the January restricted service into November 1996 is an accepted moderate-confidence assumption. Placement under Internet, selector 3, listing geometry, examples, previews, confirmation, return behavior and browser download are category D reconstruction. The text-only sample subset does not imply that historical FTP carried only text files. Exact PC-VAN FTP syntax remains unknown after focused live searches.

Implementation findings:

- `src/netnews.ts:renderInternetDirectory` and the Internet handler in `src/navigation.ts` expose only selectors 1 and 2. Add a separate FTP context while preserving those destinations.
- `PcvanController.selectOslFile`, `src/service-collections.ts`, `src/commands.ts` and `src/storage/controls.ts:downloadFile` already implement pinned payloads, exact return paths, explicit confirmation, single-use handoff and literal UTF-8 downloads. Reuse this lifecycle with only the small changes needed to support both services; a general FTP subsystem is unnecessary.
- `src/main.ts` connects download selection and reset/restore invalidation. FTP screens must not acquire forum, mailbox, conference, OLT or NetNews composition context.
- `tests/osl-download.spec.ts` supplies controller, command-owner, production-download, failure and invalidation precedents. `tests/netnews.spec.ts` currently treats `3` as invalid in both Internet and NetNews directories: update only the Internet expectation and retain NetNews directory rejection.
- Update README Internet guidance, `docs/research/pcvan-1996-1997.md` and existing Settings/About provenance. Keep routine Japanese terminal output concise and make the bundled-example status discoverable.

Live repository searches found no open Issues or PRs. FTP history recovered [Issue #81](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/81), which explicitly excluded FTP; no equivalent pending work was found. Searches are terminology-dependent and inventory can change.

[PR #98](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/98) and `docs/validation.md` report 352 passing checks with three workers. The initial eight-worker run had five failures whose root cause remains unresolved. These are Coordinator records, not checks run by this research graph or validation of this proposal.

Scope excludes arbitrary servers, network transport, credentials, uploads, executable/archive payloads, transfer-protocol emulation, remote storage, acquisition-history persistence, schema migrations and other missing services.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] MAIN 7 exposes working `3 FTP` without changing NetNews/TELNET selectors. Direct and index entry reach a restricted `info.mac` example list containing the two original text files. Anonymous use requires no registration, AI consent, model or external connection.
- [ ] List and preview show stable file numbers, filenames, purposes, authored dates and byte counts computed from the actual UTF-8 payloads. Preview and download preserve Japanese, whitespace, blank lines, literal markup and final newline exactly. Do not suggest these files or their metadata were recovered from PC-VAN.
- [ ] `READ number` opens the selected preview. `LIST` returns to the complete file list; `BACK` from preview returns to that list, then Internet, then the actual MAIN/index parent. `HELP` preserves context, `MAIN` clears the FTP path, and repeated visits do not accumulate parents or stale selections. Invalid, malformed, unsafe and out-of-range numbers leave the current view intact.
- [ ] `DOWNLOAD number` works only in the FTP list/preview or existing eligible OSL contexts. It pins filename, body and return context, then requests explicit `Y`; empty input and unrelated commands never approve. Preserve existing HELP, cancellation, Settings/About and MAIN semantics. Consume confirmation before asynchronous work or browser handoff so repeated/queued `Y` causes at most one download. Cancellation and synchronous handoff failure restore the correct view and require a fresh request. Report browser initiation truthfully without claiming completed disk saving or remote transfer.
- [ ] Reload, factory reset, same-tab restore and cross-tab world replacement invalidate pending acquisition, including replacement with identical JSON and invalidation during an awaited read. Reuse existing world fences and preserve the OSL lifecycle. FTP commands cannot start composition, mark mail read or enter OLT.
- [ ] Keep samples bundled outside IndexedDB and JSON backups. With automatic activity paused, demonstrate unchanged members, SIGs, forums/posts, mail/read markers, conference/OLT/NetNews records, consent, scheduling and calendar settings across browsing, cancellation and acquisition. Restored empty community collections stay empty. Preserve ordinary session/history behavior; pending approval inputs follow existing history exclusion. Observe no service-originated external requests or model loading.
- [ ] Extend existing Playwright/controller coverage for both files, exact downloaded filenames/bytes, list-versus-preview acquisition, invalid input, direct/index returns, repeated navigation, cancellation, queued confirmation, handoff failure and world invalidation. Include production keyboard journeys for an anonymous restored-empty world and a registered world, literal terminal/log output, Settings/About return context, simulated IME composing-Enter protection and usable input/scrolling at 320px. Preserve existing OSL, NetNews/TELNET, functional, storage, consent, composition and terminal pacing/skip regression coverage.
- [ ] Record sources, inspection dates, historical scope, confidence and reconstruction assumptions in existing documentation. Clearly retain uncertainty about November continuity, exact controls and the `info.mac` label's endpoint mapping. Do not import ASAHI Net controls or Info-Mac archive credentials. The Coordinator runs the documented `npm test` workflow before merge, which includes TypeScript checking and production build. An explicitly reported `--workers=3` run is acceptable given the existing record; disclose failures and worker settings without claiming the eight-worker reliability question is resolved. Review the complete diff, affected links and whitespace using existing tooling. No new framework or real-model execution is needed.

## Optional validation

Comparison with a subsequently recovered dated PC-VAN FTP manual/session. Additional browser engines or native IME checks may be useful but are not completion gates. No human, physical-terminal or subjective historical-match approval is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. This journey can be validated against local production assets before merge.
